modern_c2_q7.program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    man_patches = image_patch.find("man")
    beard_patches = image_patch.find("beard")
    
    if not man_patches or not beard_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    man_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in man_patches]
    beard_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in beard_patches]
    
    closest_man = min(man_patches, key=lambda m: min(abs(m.center - b) for b in beard_centers))
    return closest_man

modern_c2_q7.program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    chick_patches = image_patch.find("chick")
    black_patches = image_patch.find("blk")
    
    if not chick_patches or not black_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    chick_depths = [patch.compute_depth() for patch in chick_patches]
    black_depths = [patch.compute_depth() for patch in black_patches]
    
    min_chick_depth = min(chick_depths)
    max_black_depth = max(black_depths)
    
    chick_in_blk = [c for c in chick_patches if c.compute_depth() < max_black_depth and c.compute_depth() > min_chick_depth]
    
    return chick_in_blk[0] if chick_in_blk else chick_patches[0]
